author: Praxis II
title: BRBG-AR: Augmented ridge (batch × covariates) + DAQB (δ=0.15, k_density=20)
abstract: We test a label-free heterogeneous batch model by augmenting the ridge design with per-cell covariates and their batch interactions: B ⊕ (B×log_total_counts) ⊕ (B×fraction_zeros). All else unchanged (λ=0.7, γ_max=0.74; DAQB δ=0.15, k_density=20; binary edges with true distances). Hypothesis: modeling batch×covariate structure improves Cell_cycle conservation without harming mixing.
